props.text: Office cleaners in Manchester you can rely on

Cleaniq Services provides office cleaning and commercial cleaning in Manchester and across Greater Manchester. Our office cleaners keep workspaces, receptions, kitchens and washrooms clean and hygienic, following a fixed checklist on every visit so your workplace looks the same high standard every day.

A clean office matters. It's the first thing clients notice when they walk in, and it affects how your team feels about coming to work. We work early mornings, evenings and weekends, so your staff arrive to a clean office with no disruption to the working day.

To get a quote, tell us about your premises on our [commercial cleaning enquiry form](/commercial-cleaning), including the size in square metres and how often you'd like cleaning, or call us on [07846 726428](tel:+447846726428). We also clean restaurants, gyms, communal areas and event spaces, and offer [post-construction cleaning](/service/post-construction-cleaning-manchester) after office fit-outs.

props.text: Why Professional Office Cleaning Matters for Your Business

The cleanliness of your workplace sends a message — to your staff, your clients, and anyone who visits your premises. A consistently clean office communicates professionalism, attention to detail, and respect for the people who work there.

Beyond perception, workplace hygiene has a measurable impact on staff health and productivity. Studies consistently show that cleaner work environments reduce sick days and improve focus. Regular professional cleaning — particularly of high-contact surfaces like door handles, keyboards, and shared kitchen areas — significantly reduces the spread of illness.

Cleaniq Services' commercial cleaning team in Manchester works to a fixed, audited checklist — not a loose routine. Every visit meets the same standard, and our supervisors perform quality checks to ensure your expectations are consistently met.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: Office Cleaning Manchester

items.q: How often should an office be professionally cleaned?
items.a: Most offices benefit from daily or three-times-weekly cleaning. High-traffic spaces like reception areas and washrooms may require daily attention. We offer flexible schedules tailored to your footfall and budget.

items.q: Do you clean outside business hours?
items.a: Yes. We offer early morning cleans (from 6am), evening cleans, and weekend visits — whatever suits your team's schedule.
All Cleaniq Services commercial cleaners carry full public liability insurance and are background-checked. Certificates are available on request.

items.q: Can you provide a tailored cleaning specification?
items.a: Absolutely. We carry out a free site assessment and build a cleaning specification around your specific requirements — from daily washroom maintenance to weekly deep cleans.

items.q: What Manchester areas do you cover for office cleaning?
items.a: We cover all Greater Manchester business districts including City Centre, Salford Quays, Didsbury, Stockport, Trafford Park, Wythenshawe, and surrounding areas.

items.q: How much does office cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: It depends on the size of your premises, the areas that need cleaning and how often. Tell us about your workplace on our commercial cleaning form and we'll send you a quote.

items.q: How do I get an office cleaning quote?
items.a: Fill out our commercial cleaning enquiry form with the type of premises, its size in square metres and how often you'd like cleaning, or call us on 07846 726428.

items.q: Do you clean other commercial premises?
items.a: Yes. As well as offices, we clean restaurants, gyms, communal areas and event spaces, and provide contract cleaning across Greater Manchester.

items.q: Can you do a one-off office deep clean?
items.a: Yes. Tell us what you need on our commercial cleaning form and we'll quote for a one-off clean. After building work, our post-construction cleaning removes fine dust and debris.

Workspaces, kitchens, washrooms, reception and communal areas: desks and phones wiped, bins emptied, floors vacuumed and mopped, kitchens and washrooms cleaned. The full office cleaning checklist is on this page.
